experiment: L19-T368 activation on saved unanswerable-question answers
label: Onset of Refusal or Ignorance Statements
intervention: none; observation only, no model output or attention modification
measurement: FP32 released JumpReLU gate evaluated on standardized BF16 residual entering layer-19 post-attention layernorm. Full contribution norm is also recorded.
gate_definition: raw = z dot e_368 + bias_368; gate = raw if raw > threshold_368 and raw > 0, otherwise 0
selection: All 10 saved baseline cases with is_answerable=false; fixed earlier manual labels give 4 unsupported answers and 6 abstention decisions.
replay: One case at a time, identical saved chat token IDs, cached native-model prefill then saved output tokens in order. Assert every next-token argmax reproduces the saved greedy response through EOS.
positions: All indices zero-based. Record response-relative index and full-chat index. Plot visible answer tokens; EOS recorded separately and excluded from summary statistics and heatmaps.
token_timing: Gate measured while processing an answer token can influence later tokens; it did not produce that already emitted token. Also record final-prompt-position gate, which participates in predicting the first output token.
lifecycle_policy: Reuse SPAR instance 55946393; retain GPU and attached disk as previously requested.
